description: Expandable sections that reveal content when their titles are triggered.

howToUse: Use it for content people read in parts and seldom all at once: FAQ, filters by group, sections of a long form.
Write titles that say what is inside, so people find the part without opening all of them.
Use `type="multiple"` when people compare parts, and `defaultValue` to open the most read one.
Use `variant="plain"` inside cards, where the outer border would repeat.
alternatives: Sections people switch between often: Tabs.
A single block that opens and closes: Collapsible.

keyboard.action: Moves from one title to the next.

props.name: type
props.description: single = only one open at a time; multiple = several.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.

props.name: variant
props.description: plain removes the outer box, keeping the dividers between items.

props.name: size
props.description: Compact scale for dense compositions; default keeps the current scale.

props.name: leadingIndicator
props.description: Also shows an arrow to the left of the title (">" closed, "∨" open). Default `false`.

props.name: indentContent
props.description: With `leadingIndicator`, indents the content to align with the title text, after the arrow. Default `false`.
